## Use and Interpretation of Process Models {#sec-pmd-5}

[**Overview of Section 4.5**]{#sec-pmd-5-overview}

This section covers the interpretation and use of the models developed from the collection and analysis of data using the procedures discussed in [Section 4.3](#sec-pmd-3) and [Section 4.4](#sec-pmd-4). Three of the main uses of such models, estimation, prediction and calibration, are discussed in detail. Optimization, another important use of this type of model, is primarily discussed in Chapter 5: Process Improvement.<!-- XREF: PRI Chapter 5, Process Improvement, not yet migrated to this book; source handbook/pri/pri.htm -->
